data.body: Final CI-runtime pause-point log. Merged Gerrit 1811 / commit 8f9e40efcc742bcbb616930503dc555ba8f4dc20 after LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments. The change replaces whole-checkout build-provenance fixtures with a three-file real-Hatch package, retains isolated PEP 517 sdist-to-wheel execution in every OS/Python cell, and hardens the shared artifact probe to derive the final checkout SHA and require exact wheel/sdist provenance. Held-out RED→GREEN and exact-defect mutations passed; focused serial fell 18.23s→9.11s and per-worker setup fell 56–67%. Full Verify 31883105646 passed in 21m28s: macOS 19m45s, Ubuntu jobs 6m26s/10m37s/13m19s. No individual test exceeded 30s; only the macOS integration N=3000 import benchmark exceeded 20s at 21.43s. Completion verifier PASS covered all 21 acceptance criteria; perfect-nondeadly-shrimp closed. Post-RAM-revert full-route N=3 is 29m11s, 27m51s, 21m28s: mean 26m10s, all below 30m, but only the latest includes the final optimization, so steady-state current-main average is not yet proven. Current Ubuntu default+integration occupancy is 27m09s versus 34m26s baseline, freeing 7m17 runner-time per run (21.1%) without coverage loss. RAM disk was OSS-grounded but empirically 5.5–20% slower and remains reverted. Remaining open evidence work: organic current-main sampling on inedible-subsimious-brahmancow; required-Git-boundary import benchmark on ravenous-beribboned-walleye; no implementation-level consensus for panpsychic-clever-hawk. Per operator direction, paused after this round and started no new optimization or control-only CI run.
